brief:
Leaked internal communications between Israel's military and Foreign Ministry reveal a decision to stop a public relations attack on the filmmakers behind a documentary titled "Nazi," according to Hebrew Channel 12. Officials sought to avoid generating international attention to the project.

The directive surfaced amid accusations that Prime Minister Netanyahu's office weaponized the issue for electoral purposes and connected it to security investigations.

title: Israeli military, foreign ministry halted media campaign against 'Nazi' filmmakers
